scripts.features:
Auto Shelf Stocker – Automatically stocks shelves and handles supply boxes.

Auto Chef / Grill – Automates cooking, grilling, and food preparation at the steak house.

Auto Janitor / Mop – Automatically cleans puddles and mops floors.

Auto Scavenger – Automatically searches dumpsters for trash and loot.

Auto ATM Hacker – Automates ATM interactions for hacking, depositing, and withdrawing money.

Auto Crate Collector – Automatically opens and collects loot crates.

Fast Automation – Reduces delays between automated actions.

Walk Speed Control – Adjusts movement speed from 8 to 80.

Jump Height Control – Adjusts jump power from 23 to 120.

Unlimited Sprint – Prevents stamina from running out while sprinting.

Auto Pathfinding – Automatically travels to 27+ locations around the map.

Field of View – Adjusts the camera FOV from 70 to 120.

Anti-Ragdoll / Fall – Prevents falling over or entering a ragdoll state.

Incognito Mode – Hides your overhead name tag.

Instant Respawn – Automatically reloads your character after death.

Combat Monitor – Notifies you when another player leaves while in combat.

Panic / Safe Reset – Quickly reloads or resets your character.

Night Vision / Brightness – Improves visibility by maximizing lighting.

Lighting Adjustment – Manually adjusts environmental brightness.

Item & Object Tracker – Highlights dropped items, chests, and ATMs through walls.

Status Overlay – Displays Health, Speed, Ping, and FPS.

Server Hop – Switches to another server.

Rejoin Server – Rejoins the current server.

Join Smallest Server – Finds and joins a server with fewer players.

Silent Startup – Starts the hub without showing unnecessary interface elements.

Menu Keybind – Changes the key used to toggle the interface.

Auto-Save Config – Automatically saves settings for future sessions.
